signal: Spekit shipped a major platform release with 25+ features unifying knowledge and deal intelligence, and was named a Visionary in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Revenue Enablement.

email.body1:
Ben, saw Spekit shipped 25-plus features unifying knowledge and deal intelligence and landed as a Visionary in the 2025 Gartner MQ.

A release that big plus the analyst momentum usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns buying signals into booked meetings with zero rep time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Spekit off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ben, quick follow-up for Spekit.

You sell signal-to-revenue, so you know the trap: most RevOps teams have the signals but lose days getting them researched, written, and into a rep's hands. The measurable lift comes from collapsing that latency, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I would make. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Ben, last bit of proof for Spekit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, live in four weeks with every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Spekit's reply rate likely compares to peer enablement startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ben, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into meetings faster isn't a RevOps priority right now, no problem at all. A 25-feature release makes for a busy quarter, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a pipeline gap analysis scoped to Spekit's motion? I will tailor it to your team either way.
